nodes.name: hypothetical_workflow_weeks
nodes.description: Separate invented cohort rates for teaching difference-in-differences. These are not PlayStation, Lifepal, or six-title operational data and carry no sampling uncertainty estimate.

nodes.name: platform_dbt_model_runs
nodes.description: Invented daily dbt run history, one row per model per scheduled run, as a dbt on-run-end hook would log it.

nodes.name: platform_query_attribution
nodes.description: Invented per-user, per-day attributed credits shaped like ACCOUNT_USAGE.QUERY_ATTRIBUTION_HISTORY. Each workload runs under its own service user.

nodes.name: platform_warehouse_budget
nodes.description: Invented resource-monitor quota per warehouse, mirroring a Snowflake CREDIT_QUOTA assignment. One warehouse per workload.

nodes.name: platform_warehouse_metering
nodes.description: Invented daily credits per warehouse for September 2026, shaped like ACCOUNT_USAGE.WAREHOUSE_METERING_HISTORY. Includes one backfill spike on NEXUS_DBT_WH.

nodes.name: partner_platform.raw_partners
nodes.description: One current row per synthetic partner. Partner name, region and current tier depend on partner_id rather than being copied into title or event rows.

nodes.name: partner_platform.raw_publications
nodes.description: One storefront publication event per row. Storefront region depends on publication_id; title and partner attributes are referenced by key.

nodes.name: partner_platform.raw_submissions
nodes.description: One row per review attempt; status, build version and return reason depend on submission_id, while title attributes stay in raw_titles. A return reason is recorded only for rejected attempts.

nodes.name: partner_platform.raw_titles
nodes.description: One current row per synthetic title. partner_id is a foreign key; partner attributes stay in raw_partners.

nodes.name: cost_warehouse_daily
nodes.description: Daily credits and cost per warehouse up to var('cost_as_of_date'). Compute and cloud-services credits are kept apart, as Snowflake bills them.

nodes.name: mart_cost_by_user
nodes.description: Month-to-date credits attributed to each service user and role. Attribution excludes idle time, so it is always below metered compute.

nodes.name: mart_workflow_did_demo
nodes.description: Difference-in-differences arithmetic over a separate, entirely invented two-cohort weekly fixture.

nodes.name: dim_partner
nodes.description: One row per partner; a synthetic current-state dimension.

nodes.name: dim_title
nodes.description: One row per game or content title.

nodes.name: int_submission_lifecycle
nodes.description: Review attempts ordered within each title. One row per submission.

nodes.name: mart_cost_budget_vs_actual
nodes.description: One row per warehouse. Month-to-date credits against the resource-monitor quota, a straight-line forecast to month end, and a status that follows the monitor's notify and suspend triggers.

nodes.name: mart_cost_by_model
nodes.description: Month-to-date dbt warehouse credits allocated to each model by its share of that day's execution time. The allocation reconciles to the metered NEXUS_DBT_WH total.

nodes.name: mart_cost_daily
nodes.description: One row per warehouse per day with cumulative month-to-date credits and a trailing seven-day baseline. Days above var('cost_anomaly_ratio') times the baseline are flagged.

nodes.name: platform_cost_and_lineage
nodes.description: The platform page of this site. Budget against actual, daily burn and anomalies, cost by user and by dbt model, and the dbt lineage graph. All cost data is invented.

nodes.name: fct_submission
nodes.description: One row per publishing review attempt.

nodes.name: int_partner_review_features
nodes.description: One row per submission with partner review history available at submission time. The current review duration remains the observed label.

nodes.name: int_partner_tier_asof_submission
nodes.description: Partner tier valid at submission time; events before the first snapshot capture remain unknown.

nodes.name: int_title_outcomes
nodes.description: One row per title; submission and publication streams are aggregated separately before joining to prevent fanout.

nodes.name: mart_resubmission_cost
nodes.description: One row per return reason. Rejected attempts, reviewer hours spent on them, and the days each rejection added before the partner resubmitted.

nodes.name: int_title_publication_features
nodes.description: One row per approved title. Partner history is calculated separately at first submission and at approval, using only titles published strictly before each point. Current publication remains an observed outcome.

nodes.name: mart_partner_publishing
nodes.description: Partner-level publishing health. All title outcomes are combined at title grain before this aggregation.

nodes.name: mart_partner_statistical_diagnostics
nodes.description: Descriptive partner and overall summaries; Wilson calculations are teaching examples, not intervals inferred from a random sample.

nodes.name: mart_title_time_to_shelf
nodes.description: One row per title at a fixed clock, var('opportunity_as_of_date'). Shows whether an approved title has reached a storefront, how long it has waited and how much slack remains before its planned release. Events after the clock are treated as unobserved.

nodes.name: partner_release_health
nodes.description: A possible partner operations dashboard using the governed publishing mart; no PlayStation dashboard has been deployed.

nodes.name: mart_partner_health
nodes.description: One row per partner. An illustrative health score in [0, 1] from three equally weighted components (Wilson lower bound on first-pass approval, recency, shelf conversion). Weights are a discussion starting point, not a validated model; low-sample partners are flagged and should not be ranked.

nodes.name: partner_opportunity
nodes.description: A possible view for partner managers covering titles waiting for the shelf, the cost of resubmissions by return reason, and partner health. Illustrative only; no PlayStation dashboard has been deployed.
